title: Founding of the PEAR lab by Bob Jahn

tellings.quote:
The PEAR lab was started in 1979
by the dean of the engineering school, a guy named Bob Jahn.
The guy that started the Princeton parapsychology lab was a plasma physicist and propulsion engineer named Bob Jahn.
tellings.difference: Calls Jahn a plasma physicist and propulsion engineer instead of the engineering dean, gives no 1979 date, and cites Margins of Reality.
tellings.link_reason: Both are about Bob Jahn founding the Princeton PEAR lab.

as_told.title: Bob Jahn founds the Princeton parapsychology lab

plain: In 1979 Bob Jahn, dean of Princeton's engineering school, started the PEAR lab, a laboratory at Princeton that studied the paranormal. Michels tells this himself on two episodes. In the later one he calls Jahn a plasma physicist and propulsion engineer, gives no date, and draws on the book Margins of Reality. He tells it to show that serious scientists at an elite university took the paranormal seriously.
